dev.description: Starts the local Astro development server with HMR.

build.description: Compiles the production static bundle into dist/.

preview.description: Locally previews the built static site from dist/.

check.description: Runs Astro diagnostics and TypeScript static type checks.

test.description: Runs source-level journey and project-page contract tests without requiring a prebuilt dist/.

smoke.description: Validates the built dist/ artifact, routes, links and structural integrity.

verify.description: Builds the site, runs source-level tests, then validates the built artifact with smoke checks.
